name: @agntux/agntux-build-test-harness
description: Headless UI test harness for agntux-build. Spawns the in-plugin host-renderer (which spawns the plugin's MCP server), POSTs /__test/render with a tool + args, returns screenshot + console errors + structuredContent. No MCPJam Inspector required — that's the whole point.

scripts.syntax-check: node --check bin/cli.mjs && node --check src/render.mjs && node --check src/host-spawn.mjs && node --check src/parse-flags.mjs
